t: Real Research Today: Neural Learning Interfaces
title: Real Research Today: Neural Learning Interfaces
definition: Today's documented research behind Neural Learning Interfaces.
description:
The road to Neural Learning Interfaces is already being paved. Finland's phenomenon-based learning reorganizes school around topics, not subjects. Sleep-learning research (Weizmann, Northwestern) shows targeted memory reactivation during sleep.

The OECD's Learning Compass 2030 defines future-ready competencies for schools. Together these programs form the neural tutors foundation that Neural Learning Interfaces will build on — the interface logistics results, the safety trials methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as interface logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Neural Learning Interfaces
definition: Estimates Neural Learning Interfaces readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Neural Learning Interfaces components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a interface hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Neural Learning Interfaces Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Neural Learning Interfaces operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Neural Learning Interfaces installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 81985 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where neural tutors monitoring, interface logistics redundancy, or safety trials maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Neural Learning Interfaces Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Neural Learning Interfaces: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Neural Learning Interfaces — interfaces accelerating learning via neural tech.

Phase 1 — Prove (neural tutors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (interface logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (safety trials): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (learning gains): interface hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and students-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
